lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical bands; approximately 7-8 columns are visible between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin, organized into roughly 5 horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Internal area of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs, primarily distributed across the anterior and basal regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast elongated feature (remora) swimming in the water column directly ventral to the shark's midsection.
